title: A Decomposition Method for LQ Conditional McKean-Vlasov Control Problems with Random Coefficients
summary: We propose a decomposition method for solving a general class of linear-quadratic (LQ) McKean-Vlasov control problems involving conditional expectations and random coefficients, where the system dynamics are driven by two independent Wiener processes. Unlike existing approaches in the literature for these problems, such as the extended stochastic maximum principle and the extended dynamic programming methods, which often involve additional technical complexities and sometimes impose restrictive conditions on control inputs, our approach decomposes the original McKean-Vlasov control problem…
